## Instructions

Mini Exam 2 covers textbook §§2.1.9 (Elementary Matrices), 2.1.10 (More on Matrix Inverses), 3.1 (Basic Techniques and Properties of determinants), 4.10.1 (Spanning Set of Vectors), and 4.10.2 (Linearly Independent Set of Vectors). The review is not exhaustive. If a problem gives you trouble, work more similar problems from the textbook until you are comfortable with the ideas.

There are five numbered review items: one study direction and four mathematical exercises. Preserve both determinant methods in Problem 3. In Problem 2(c), infer the reversed product from row operations without multiplying the matrices.
